edition: Unofficial Zork Underground Sensory Physicality Glulx
player_outcomes: an early cross-section of the Great Underground Empire reads as materially distinct stone, earth, air, damp, dust, echo, and height rather than interchangeable room text

ambient smelling and listening use existing sensory verbs and existing air/draft objects; the Cellar deliberately preserves its established cross-draft authority while other authored underground rooms provide room-specific air and acoustic responses

walls in the Cellar, Troll Room, East-West Passage, Round Room, Loud Room, Damp Cave, North-South Passage, Chasm, and Deep Canyon support authored examination, touch, smell, listening, kicking, taking, tool impacts, and thrown-object responses
plain WALL resolves to the local surrounding stone in the authored underground circuit while explicit GRANITE WALL remains available to the canonical granite-wall object

hard existing tools and the real loose field stone can leave a persistent scoreless cosmetic scar tied to the current authored underground room without changing that room's canonical movement flags, creating a universal destruction system, or opening a new passage
ordinary thrown objects strike underground stone and remain where they land instead of teleporting back into inventory
the canonical bottle, jewel-encrusted egg, and brass lantern are deliberately excluded from generic underground projectile handling so their existing object authorities remain in charge
existing stone stairs and narrow cracks gain room-aware examination and sensory responses without a second movement or opening system
the Loud Room retains its canonical ECHO puzzle and special command loop while its ordinary prose and post-ECHO sensory behavior become more physical

the Chasm retains its canonical pseudo-object removal and crossing authority while impossible DOWN, LEAP, CROSS, and THROW-OFF outcomes are described in physical rather than player-psychological terms
developer environmental reset clears Release 1249 cosmetic underground scars together with existing bounded physical damage and does not rewind canonical puzzle progress
boundaries: no universal physics engine, arbitrary object-pair matrix, generic trajectory simulator, or generic cave generator
no new global variables; underground scar state remains inside the existing material-consequence authority in a bounded constant companion table shared by production and dev/test
no room RMUNGBIT mutation for cosmetic underground scars because canonical GOTO treats RMUNGBIT destinations as impassable
no alternate bottle, egg, lantern, chasm, Loud Room, combat, death, movement, or scoring authority
no wall destruction that opens an unearned route or bypasses canonical locks, puzzles, troll gating, or cave-ins
no score for wall damage, throwing objects, or reckless experimentation
no player mental-state inference or moralizing refusal where a physical explanation is available
no production cheat/reset verb and no reset of Mara history, score, treasures, or unrelated puzzle state
no TODO, stub, placeholder behavior, or no-op scaffolding
